moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Musk shared an alternate Star Wars ending image featuring Anakin ruling the Empire with his family
moments.why: It tapped into young conservative men’s frustrations by turning Anakin Skywalker into a MAGA meme that’s now widespread

moments.author: Draymond Green
moments.handle: — implied via his action reported on X
moments.quote: His ejection after a wild scuffle with Suns players—dragging Maluach down and grabbing Brooks by the throat—blew up
moments.why: The chaos lit up feeds and sports talk, becoming a defining viral moment from last night’s game

moments.author: The White House
moments.quote: Fighting harder than ever for the American people. THE HARDEST WORKING PRESIDENT IN HISTORY.
moments.why: With Election Day now underway, the post’s bombastic tone is trending as everybody rallies around the midterms

moments.author: Gavin Newsom
moments.quote: Tomorrow, we deliver the verdict on the most corrupt president in America history.
moments.why: His dramatic framing of Election Day spurred strong reactions across the political spectrum and is going viral
